feature: E005-F004: HookProvider Enum and Provider Abstraction
story: E005-F004-S001: Implement HookProvider enum for multi-CLI hook support
story_description: As a developer integrating multiple CLI tools, I need a unified HookProvider enum that encapsulates provider-specific configuration paths, event definitions, and capability flags so that the hooks system can seamlessly support Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and future providers without scattered conditionals.
task: E005-F004-S001-T001: Create HookProvider enum with provider properties
task_description: Implement the HookProvider Swift enum with cases for claude, gemini, and codex. Include computed properties for supportsHooks, configDirectoryName, settingsFilename, and events array that returns provider-specific HookEventDefinition collections.
atom_description: Create the foundational HookProvider enum in Blaze/Sources/Core/Hooks/HookProvider.swift that defines provider cases and their associated configuration. This enum serves as the single source of truth for provider-specific hook capabilities and paths throughout the application.
problem_statement: The current hooks implementation is Claude-specific with hardcoded paths and event types. To support Gemini CLI and OpenAI Codex CLI, we need a provider abstraction that encapsulates: (1) whether the provider supports hooks at all, (2) the config directory name for that provider, (3) the settings filename convention, and (4) the available hook events for each provider. Without this abstraction, adding new providers would require scattered conditionals throughout the codebase.
scope_in: Define HookProvider enum with claude, gemini, codex cases
Implement supportsHooks computed property returning Bool based on provider capability
Implement configDirectoryName computed property returning provider-specific directory string
Implement settingsFilename computed property returning settings.json constant
Implement events computed property returning array of HookEventDefinition for each provider
Add Codable conformance for serialization in settings
Add CaseIterable conformance for UI iteration
Add RawValue String conformance for display and logging
scope_out: HookEventDefinition types themselves (covered by H002-SCHEMA atom)
ClaudeHookEvents.all and GeminiHookEvents.all constants (covered by H002-SCHEMA atom)
HookRunner provider parameter modification (covered by H004-RUNNER atom)
UI components for provider selection (covered by H005-UIPROVIDER atom)
Hook description field implementation (covered by H006-DESCRIPTION atom)
assumptions: HookEventDefinition type will be defined in a parallel or preceding atom (H002-SCHEMA)
ClaudeHookEvents and GeminiHookEvents namespaces will provide static all property
Codex CLI does not currently support hooks (supportsHooks returns false)
All providers use settings.json as their settings filename
constraints: Must use Swift enum with String raw value for Codable serialization
Must conform to CaseIterable for SwiftUI ForEach iteration
Must be thread-safe (enums are inherently value types)
Must not import UI frameworks (Core layer isolation)
File must be placed in Blaze/Sources/Core/Hooks/ directory

functional_requirements: FR-001: HookProvider enum SHALL define exactly three cases: claude, gemini, codex
FR-002: supportsHooks property SHALL return true for claude and gemini, false for codex
FR-003: configDirectoryName property SHALL return .claude for claude case, .gemini for gemini case, .codex for codex case
FR-004: settingsFilename property SHALL return settings.json for all cases
FR-005: events property SHALL return ClaudeHookEvents.all for claude case
FR-006: events property SHALL return GeminiHookEvents.all for gemini case
FR-007: events property SHALL return empty array for codex case
FR-008: Enum SHALL conform to Codable protocol for JSON serialization
FR-009: Enum SHALL conform to CaseIterable protocol for iteration
FR-010: Enum raw value type SHALL be String for human-readable serialization
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR-001: Enum instantiation and property access SHALL complete in under 1 microsecond
NFR-002: Memory footprint of HookProvider instance SHALL be 8 bytes or less (single String pointer)
NFR-003: Code SHALL compile without warnings on Swift 5.9+
NFR-004: File SHALL have 100% documentation coverage with DocC comments
implementation_steps: Step 1: Create new file Blaze/Sources/Core/Hooks/HookProvider.swift with standard header comment
Step 3: Define enum HookProvider: String, Codable, CaseIterable with cases claude, gemini, codex
Step 4: Implement supportsHooks computed property with switch statement returning appropriate Bool
Step 5: Implement configDirectoryName computed property with switch statement returning directory strings
Step 6: Implement settingsFilename computed property returning settings.json constant
Step 7: Implement events computed property with switch statement returning appropriate HookEventDefinition arrays
Step 8: Add DocC documentation comments for enum and all public properties
Step 9: Add MARK comments for code organization
Step 10: Verify file compiles without errors or warnings
data_model_changes: New enum type HookProvider added to Core/Hooks module
HookProvider conforms to Codable, CaseIterable protocols
api_contracts: HookProvider.allCases returns array of all three cases in declaration order
event_contracts: No events emitted by this atom (enum is passive data type)
Events property returns HookEventDefinition array but does not emit events itself
edge_cases: Edge case 1: Decoding unknown provider string from JSON should fail gracefully with DecodingError
Edge case 2: Future provider addition should only require adding new case and implementing computed properties
Edge case 3: Empty events array for codex should be handled by callers without crashing
Edge case 4: Config directory names must not contain path separators or special characters
Edge case 5: Raw value string must match case name exactly for predictable serialization
failure_modes: FM-001: If ClaudeHookEvents or GeminiHookEvents types are not defined, compilation fails with undefined symbol error - Mitigation: Ensure H002-SCHEMA atom is completed first or use forward declaration
FM-002: If events property returns nil instead of empty array, callers may crash on force unwrap - Mitigation: Return empty array explicitly for unsupported providers
FM-003: If raw value string differs from case name, JSON round-trip may produce unexpected results - Mitigation: Use implicit raw values (no explicit assignment)
rollback_plan: Delete Blaze/Sources/Core/Hooks/HookProvider.swift file. Remove any imports of HookProvider from dependent files. Revert to hardcoded Claude-only paths in existing code. No data migration required as this is a new type with no persistent storage.
